our_interpretation: The speaker hedged ('it appears'), so this is not graded as a claim of strict mathematical proportionality. The ordinary reading is looser: Anthropic's costs kept rising roughly in step with revenue in the quarters before Q2 2026, and Q2 2026 was the one quarter that broke from that pattern.

'Costs' means total operating expenses (revenue minus operating income), with compute and infrastructure as the main part. 'Second quarter' means calendar Q2 2026 (April to June).
The word 'magically' implies something suspicious. That motive is not graded here. Only the pattern in the numbers is graded.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Costs had already stopped keeping pace with revenue before Q2 2026, for example in Q1 2026, so Q2 was not the single break. Or costs did not track revenue in 2025 either.
